sections.overview: This slender-bodied piranha occurs in the Amazon and Orinoco river basins.
sections.identification: The species reaches about 30 cm total length in the records summarized by FishBase.
sections.habitat: It is a tropical freshwater, benthopelagic fish.
sections.diet: Studies describe adults as specialized fin- and scale-feeders, though they may also consume other fish material and aquatic insects.
sections.behavior: The species summaries consulted provide little detail on social or daily behavior.
sections.reproduction: The species-level summaries consulted do not give verified reproductive details.
sections.ecology: Its fin- and scale-feeding is a distinctive trophic niche among piranhas.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern, dated 2020.
